I am 67 years old now, and my bones are not as strong as they used to be, but I know this 0.61-hectare plot well because it belongs to my family. I will plant hybrid maize because it gives better yield, and I will put both chemical fertilizer from the subsidy program and manure from my cattle on the land to make it fertile. Since I intercrop with legumes here, I need family members to help me weed by hand, and I will hire a few young people when the weeds are too many or during harvest time. We depend on the rains in Mzimba, so I will not irrigate, and I do not have money to buy pesticides when hand-weeding and mixed cropping have always managed the pests for me.
